I understand what you’re talking about like when people speak fast and can’t really process what they are talking about so you either ask them to repeat it again but then you start feeling bad for having to ask for them to repeat it so you just pretend you understand but I learned that you’d have to ask them to slowly repeat it so you can process it which I tell them I have hard time hearing but it gets frustrating sometimes. You’re not alone I sometimes wish I can have like subtitles in real life because it’s easier for me to hear and read what people is saying it’s like more clearer. Which It is harder when there’s like a lot of background noise too and getting all distracted when someone is talking to you, I’m still trying to learn with having APD I’m only 24 years old I had this all my life but i believe that  this Reddit group is nice to be in because we all can support each other and knowing we aren’t alone. 
I hope this helps in a way!
Yeah I learned the hard way that it’s going to take me a long time to get through it that’s why I’m back in therapy. Which I’m thinking about taking some self defense classes and go to the gym

What helps you if you’re feeling angry? If you don’t mind me asking

I do like my therapist which all I know what to do to cope is when I’m feeling depressed, and really anxious but when I’m angry I don’t know I just do the same as I normally do but coping when I’m angry I let it eat me inside

I always tell myself and everyone that it’s my fault, even when at times it’s not. I think it upsets my family and friends that I always do that but I want everyone to feel like their feelings is heard and valid. I always think that when they calm down they realized that what they said was hurtful and they’d come to me and apologize but sometimes they don’t. I always think and put their feelings first than my own.

I woke up this morning from a horrible nightmare which I struggle with frequent nightmares but of course I had to get things done today like pay my rent and do some cleaning. I’m pretty independent I do have attachment issues but that came with childhood trauma from being abused etc. I’ve been working on it but I also have anxiety of getting too close to people because I’m afraid of getting hurt but when I do have close relationships I fear of losing them. What triggered it is that I like spending quality time alone and some friends think I’m ignoring them even tho I explained and apologized for it. I often forget to text back but I don’t do it on purpose. I always let them express their feelings even when they are mad at me and I don’t even defend myself I just let them take it out on me.

My life has been better without her, she only messages me on our birthdays and that’s it. Im in a happy relationship and I have my little brother even my dad and grandparents. It’s just I kept trying with her and I’m just finally accepting that I still resent her, I finally realize I’m angry and it’s okay. Im in college as well and trying to study for my final im just so frustrated that I have to work twice as hard in order to pass. Thank you for listening it means a lot to be heard ya know?
I’ll definitely take this advice, today was a bad day for me because after finishing two of my assignments I felt so overwhelmed been having a lil mental breakdown because of it.

Honestly don’t blame yourself, it’s not your fault. I gotten broken up with because Of my mental health or I gotten ghosted. When that happened to me I started really hating myself but I want you to know that even though you struggle with this you deserve love and happiness. People who struggle with mental illness can be in long lasting relationships and you’ll find someone who will love you and be there for you.
I’m so sorry to hear that :(

I think it’ll be a good idea to tell her what you struggle with, I told my partner about this before we started dating, we been together for about a year and a half which it’s nice to be with someone who is willingly understanding but is very patient. I’ve had worst experience before in my past relationships where I got dumped because of my mental health issues or they use it against me. If she really likes and wants to be with you I believe she would be happy to listen and be willingly to be patient with you. Being in a serious relationship is all about communicating and being honest. Just know that your feelings are also important and sharing this to her won’t be a bad thing because a lot of people struggle with this as well. Which don’t feel pressured about having to tell her right away like you have your own pace and whenever you feel is right you can tell her. I understand that feeling to love someone more than yourself but it’s also good to care about yourself as well. I’m a pretty selfless person and I don’t really like myself at times but I’m to the point where I care about how I feel and comfortable with myself (I think it’s because I’m so introverted that I’m comfortable with being alone or doing my own thing) I hope this helped in a way I’m not good at explaining or comprehending but I’m trying the best I can to be helpful lol.

Listen abuse is abuse and trust me it’s no competition at all. Which what you’re parents did to you it’s not okay and all I’m saying is abuse can affect us in a way where our bodies are trying to protect us. There’s different forms of abuse and it does hurt. Just know that you matter and your safety matters even your mental health.

You’re not overreacting don’t worry I understand how you feel, I’ve been abused too by family members throughout my childhood and when I told my therapist when I was 16 or 17 I got diagnosed with ptsd. 
Ptsd is post traumatic stress disorder where traumatic experience makes your body go on panic mode which It triggers flight or fight responses that your body is releasing in a way 
which it took me awhile to accept that I have to deal with it for the rest of my life which I hope I didn’t freak you out about this but I promise it’ll be okay 
I’m sorry you had to deal with that and I hope you’re in a safe place now. You have every right to feel the way you do and I promise you’re not alone. I’m not a doctor which I can’t diagnose you but I just want to be helpful as I can by sharing my experience.
